**Job Description**
 Visa’s Technology Organization is a community of problem solvers and innovators building and supporting systems at global scale. Within this space, our Operations \& Infrastructure engineering teams are responsible for developing and maintaining the platforms, services, and automation that ensure Visa’s systems are reliable, scalable, and secure.
   

  

 We are seeking a Software Engineer to join one of our Operations \& Infrastructure teams. In this role, you will contribute to building full\-stack applications, backend services, and automation solutions that support critical infrastructure, platform capabilities, and internal engineering systems.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity for an early\-career engineer who is passionate about software engineering, systems reliability, and building tools and platforms that operate at scale.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Software Engineer, you will work alongside experienced engineers to design, build, and improve systems that power Visa’s technology ecosystem. You will gain exposure to distributed systems, cloud platforms, automation, and modern full\-stack development, while contributing to real\-world solutions used across the organization.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate with cross\-functional teams including engineering, platform, infrastructure, and operations to deliver solutions that improve developer productivity, system reliability, and operational efficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, and full\-stack applications
* Build and support automation tools, platform capabilities, and internal systems
* Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following engineering best practices (testing, code reviews, CI/CD)
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define requirements and deliver high\-quality solutions
* Contribute to systems that improve reliability, performance, and operational efficiency
* Participate in design discussions and contribute to decisions around architecture, scalability, and system behavior
* Troubleshoot application and system issues, perform root cause analysis, and support resolution of production incidents
* Support development of cloud\-native and distributed systems
* Document technical designs, implementation details, and system behavior
* Continuously improve engineering quality, system observability, and operational excellence


 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
